targets.expected_type: ∀ {d : ℕ} (xs : Fin d → ℝ × ℝ), HiddenMonotonicity.TransformerDC.value (HiddenMonotonicity.TransformerDC.variancePair xs) = HiddenMonotonicity.TransformerDC.layerVariance (fun i => HiddenMonotonicity.TransformerDC.value (xs i))

∀ {d : ℕ} (ε : ℝ), 0 < ε → ∀ (γ β : Fin d → ℝ) (xs : Fin d → ℝ × ℝ) (i : Fin d), HiddenMonotonicity.TransformerDC.value (HiddenMonotonicity.TransformerDC.layerNormPair ε γ β xs i) = HiddenMonotonicity.TransformerDC.layerNorm ε γ β (fun j => HiddenMonotonicity.TransformerDC.value (xs j)) i

∀ {E : Type u} [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℝ E] [Preorder E] {d : ℕ} (s : Set E), Convex ℝ s → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∀ (γ β : Fin d → ℝ) (f : Fin d → E → ℝ × ℝ), (∀ i, HiddenMonotonicity.TransformerDC.Regular s (f i)) → ∀ i : Fin d, HiddenMonotonicity.TransformerDC.Regular s (fun x => HiddenMonotonicity.TransformerDC.layerNormPair ε γ β (fun j => f j x) i)
